        """Create a QwenChat adapter bound to one proxy base URL."""
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds

    def build_payload(
        self,

    ) -> dict[str, Any]:

            "stream": False,
        }
